verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a public API in depth: OAuth 2.0 client-credential auth with scoped access, a full API reference covering transfers, fiat transfers, orders, market data and orchestrations, plus webhooks, FIX and WebSocket APIs and a sandbox for end-to-end testing. llms.txt and llms-full.txt make the docs easy for AI tools to consume. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
